metadata.description: Candidate road-link endpoints whose nearest endpoint on a different road part is between 0.001 m and 0.1 m inclusive.
metadata.algorithm: For each road-part start/end, find the nearest endpoint on a different road part. Include endpoints with haversine separation >= 0.001 m and <= 0.1 m. Distances are stored in meters to micrometer precision. These are candidates for review, not confirmation that a backend build snapped them.
